steps.title: This is Today
steps.text: Your briefing, what to do tonight, and where you stand, across every class. Start here each day.

steps.title: Tonight
steps.text: The three things worth your time tonight, most important first. Hit the top one and you're winning.

steps.title: Where you stand
steps.text: Each gauge is a class grade; the tick is your target. Click one for the what-if calculator.

steps.title: Calendar
steps.text: A month view of everything due. You can add your own due dates there too.

steps.title: Your courses
steps.text: Every class lives here. Click one to open its modules, notes and study tools.

steps.title: Add a course
steps.text: Drop in a PowerPoint and I'll build flashcards from it, or set a course up by hand.

steps.title: Blackboard
steps.text: Connect once, then Sync. Assignments, grades, announcements and files come straight over.

steps.title: Jump anywhere
steps.text: Ctrl+K opens the command palette. Type a course or chapter to go straight there.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: The gear opens Settings: reduce motion, my settings, and the AI key. Click me any time for quizzes, help, or the course tour. I don't bite. Usually.
